items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, private-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, keep external outreach unsent, and continue bounded read-only evidence work only. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish public or commercial reuse rights; compliance is technical-only with 37 passes, 15 failures, and 7 unknowns; fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; analytics quality is yellow with source issues; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only and includes $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable; accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising expansion.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Progress: official API documentation, public terms, support documentation, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and the private gate are recorded; they do not establish launch permission or complete processing evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked because rights to fetch, store, transform, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize are not established. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. The concrete next action for each is a timestamped site-specific checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookie behavior, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, age-sensitive concerns where applicable, and an explicit retain-parked or bounded-launch decision. Do not expose or monetize before completion.
